checks.title: Xu ly gia tri rong khong nhat quan trong cung payload insert_variants (Weight vs Compare price)

steps: De trong Weight va Compare price, dien cac field con lai hop le
Bam Add
Quan sat payload insert_variants: Weight va Compare price duoc gui the nao
Quan sat gia tri luu lai khi doc lai variant

checks.expected_result: BASELINE: Weight rong duoc gui duoi dang chuoi rong ""; Compare price rong bi loai han khoi payload (khong gui field); ket qua luu khac nhau: weight='' con compare_at_price=null. Day la hanh vi hien tai, can dieu tra neu gay sai lech du lieu khi query/hien thi lai

checks.title: Pham vi unique SKU thuc su o server (INFERRED, chua verify constraint DB)
checks.precondition: Co 2 product base khac nhau trong cung store
steps: Ghi nhan 1 SKU da ton tai o product base A
Thu insert_variants voi SKU y het do nhung product_id la product base B (khac product_id, cung fulfillment_linked_id hoac khac)
Quan sat server co chap nhan hay chan
checks.observation_point: Response cua insert_variants khi SKU trung nhung product_id khac
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra
checks.open_question: KB-041 la INFERRED (suy tu query pre-check getVariant dung where (product_id, fulfillment_linked_id) + hanh vi clone giu nguyen SKU khi tao ban sao), CHUA co test insert truc tiep len server de xac nhan DB constraint that. Theo dieu kien CONDITIONAL_PASS cua feature profile FEAT-05: KB-041 KHONG duoc dung lam oracle/business rule. Can gui thang insert_variants voi SKU trung (khac product_id) de xac nhan pham vi unique constraint that o server.

Quan sat trang thai cua 5 radio (disabled/enabled, checked/unchecked)

checks.expected_result: BASELINE: ca 5 radio (color_display_type, size_display_type) deu disabled va KHONG radio nao checked, mac du record co color_display_type='radio' san co; chi 'Edit label' dung duoc; khi Save, payload KHONG gui 2 field display_type. Co the la UI bug khien user tuong chua cau hinh gi - can dieu tra neu day khong phai chu y
